description: NIST's CTC-05, its AP242 e1 edition's solid #1205 alone (excerpted by tools/oracle/excerpt.py), cut by its battery's box: the box's plane f156 crosses the rational B-spline face f109, degree (3, 2) over a single span each way — one rational Bézier patch, the AP203 edition's face written with fewer knots — open in both directions, no pole, the only NURBS face the box reaches. Arris refuses it Unsupported(NURBS surface × plane surface), where Open CASCADE builds it (plans/nurbs-analytic-section step 1). The desired body is Open CASCADE's; the tolerances are those of Open CASCADE's own quadrature on the part's B-spline faces, which reads the AP203 and AP242 editions of this one part 1e-6 apart in volume and Arris's exact integral of the uncut part the same distance from either (plans/nurbs-analytic-section step 7)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE heals the file before it cuts and its result carries 216 vertices and 324 edges to Arris's 209 and 317 on the same faces (129) and loops (170); the body, its measures and probes agree
